body:
Re-checked §12 item 4 (phone-app parity) before building anything and found the premise wrong: BIG_O already has a full, rendered phone UI (draw_bigo_phone, landed 2026-09-20, predates this reverse-port thread) -- 'no on-screen UI either' was false. Also found phase 5's own claim that SHANKPIT never built a cake distraction was false -- witness_ai_smash_cake is real and halves witness vigilance; the real blocker is that BIG_O's live day server only wires the LOUD-event witness path, not the QUIET-decorum path cake-smash needs (a real, separate, pre-existing, already-named gap, just misattributed). Fixed a real, small, adjacent display bug: PC_ITEM_TABLE in day/apps/client/src/main.c only covered 2 of 25 real item ids -- weapons showed Unknown Item before this thread touched anything, and phase 5's new food items would have too. Added weapon names + a real bigo_food_items.h-backed lookup for food ids. Verified live via a scratch #include main.c harness against the real client binary, 7/7 pass. bazel test //... 36/36 green, scripts/build_client.sh clean. NORTHSTAR.md §17, CHANGELOG.md.

⚓ ☃
title: SECTION 536 phase 6: correct 2 wrong claims + fix real item-name display gap
